content.caption: Green check mark icon marking enabled wiki access in the WikiSkill ablation table
content.description: A small green check mark (tick) on a plain white background, with a short left stroke and a longer stroke rising to the upper right. On the page it is the symbol used in Table 3, the ablation study of WikiSkill with Gemini-3.5-Flash, under the 'WikiSkill Components' columns. It indicates that wiki access is enabled for a component (Inference Agent Wiki Access or Skill Proposer Wiki Access) in a given configuration. Its counterpart, a red cross, marks access as disabled. Check marks appear in three places. The Inference Agent column is checked in the second row (Skill Proposer crossed, average 45.3) and in the fourth row (both checked, average 60.9). The Skill Proposer column is checked in the fourth row and in the bottom row (Inference Agent crossed, average 63.7). The bottom row is the default WikiSkill configuration and has the highest average.
